signals.claim: 0% boom rate for WR stable-players coming off a bust season — vs 21% for WR stable-players (2020-2025, n=18)
signals.detail: Cohort: WR stable-players coming off a bust season. Boom 0% · hit 39% · bust 33% · median -19 pts vs slot expectation. n=18, 2020-2025. Baseline: WR stable-players at 21% (n=157). Boom/bust = top/bottom 20% of outcomes for the same position and draft slot.
